docs.remarks: Schedule PostgreSQL maintenance for every trusted compatibility/catalog registration, with cancellation and observed failures. It uses locked database-clock checks, never executes model or tool work, and never extends private retention. Active owners remain unchanged; consumed decisions and uncertain effects remain fenced. Retained lease reconciliation is registration-specific; privacy purge is schema-wide. Backlog and scheduling govern recovery latency. Custom journals define their own maintenance behavior; implementing this interface does not imply PostgreSQL crash reconciliation or browser recovery support.
